posts.name: DraftCareer
posts.tagline: Search jobs, tailor your resume to each one, apply — free
posts.description: DraftCareer is a resume and cover letter builder that doesn't stop at the PDF. Search real jobs across 22 countries, tailor your resume and cover letter to a listing with one click, and apply — all from one profile. 46 templates, built around real roles — clean ATS-safe single-column designs, and bold two-column layouts for a human reviewer. AI writing-assist helps you draft summaries, bullet points, and cover letters, but always leaves you to review and edit. Free to start. No watermark, ever.

posts.name: Difframe
posts.tagline: Overlay a live site or Figma prototype on the page you build
posts.description: Difframe overlays a reference site or Figma prototype on the page you're building — as a live iframe, not a screenshot. Because the reference is a real page, it never goes stale and scrolls like the real thing. Switch on Difference blend mode and every matching area turns black, leaving only the misalignment on screen. Presets store the URL, opacity, scale, size, position and blend mode, scoped per tab, page or host — so two tabs can compare desktop and mobile at once. Free, MIT, no tracking.

posts.name: ROADSTAT
posts.tagline: Intelligent Asset Tracking: Uninterrupted, Reliable Tracking
posts.description: ROADSTAT eradicates key challenges of traditional GPS tracking including: 1. IOT based Tracking - more reliable, secure and uninterrupted tracking 2. No dependence on vehicle battery 2. No dependence on Mobile phone for tracking data 3. No wiring or installation needed 4. No CAPEX, 100% Subscription model 5. IP67 grade - works in extreme harsh environment ROADSTAT is the first and only kind of offering in this domain

posts.name: Alien Task
posts.tagline: Project Management, From Another Dimension
posts.description: Futuristic project & workspace management built for founders, operations managers, and high-velocity teams. Kanban boards, workload analytics, AI copilot, and seamless multi-company collaboration.

posts.name: Saqi
posts.tagline: Arabic poetry with English translations
posts.description: Saqi is a free index of 90,000+ Arabic poems from 1,100+ poets. Browse original Arabic text alongside English translations—no account required.

posts.name: Shop Route: Smart Grocery List
posts.tagline: Add groceries faster. Shop with less effort.
posts.description: Shop Route is built for maximum speed, seamless UX, and zero supermarket backtracking • Hands-Free Voice Input: Dictate multiple items at once with automatic quantity parsing. • Instant AI Categorization: Automatic assignment to departments via built-in catalog & Gemini edge AI. • Store Route Flow: Arranges items along the natural walking path from entrance to checkout. • Frictionless UX: Quick-add habits, fast tapping, zero clutter.

posts.name: Etcetra
posts.tagline: Reading Noise Distilled in the Age of AI
posts.description: Etcetra is a productivity tool that turns URLs (relating to articles, papers, and blogs) into structured, searchable notes, which end up being part of your local second brain - thereby helping reduce the reading noise in this age of AI.

posts.name: Provoon
posts.tagline: Collect, manage, and showcase testimonials - powered by AI
posts.description: Unlike other testimonial tools that just collect and display, Provoon uses AI to auto-tag sentiment and surface your strongest testimonials automatically. Auto-send invites via your own email, custom domain support, and one-click social media export turn testimonials into ready-to-post content - not just a wall. Collect text, video, and audio via one link, embed anywhere. Built solo, launched today.

posts.name: GolfHub
posts.tagline: All your golf, in one place.
posts.description: Follow your favourite golfers across PGA Tour, LIV Golf, DP World Tour, Challenge Tour and more. Live leaderboards, player profiles, career stats and tournament history — all in one place.

posts.name: Sleevy
posts.tagline: One tap to save. Read anywhere. Built to automate.
posts.description: Links pile up everywhere — open tabs, chat messages, "read this later" promises. Sleevy catches them: one tap from iOS, Chrome, Raycast, or the web, and everything lands in a single synced reading queue. Each link is enriched automatically with titles, favicons, and suggested tags, so your queue stays organized without you doing the filing. And when you want to automate, there's a REST API and MCP server built in. Save links. Read them later.

posts.name: RecordRecharge
posts.tagline: Your customer data, cleaned and enriched.
posts.description: Clean, verify, and complete your customer database. Fix duplicates, correct bad data, append missing contact and demographic data, and stop wasting marketing spend on bad records.

posts.name: Krionex
posts.tagline: “Deploy, verify & manage smart contracts across EVM chains.”
posts.description: Krionex is a workspace to deploy, verify, and manage smart contracts across seven EVM chains, including BNB Chain. Use guided templates for ERC20, ERC721, and ERC1155, or write custom contract code in the built-in editor. A preflight check estimates gas cost and deployability before you spend anything. After deployment, manage contracts with minting, burning, role transfers, royalties, and ownership transfer. Fully non-custodial: you connect your own wallet and sign every action.

posts.name: DealCheck
posts.tagline: The independent second opinion before you sign
posts.description: DealCheck Defender helps car buyers check the deal in front of them before signing. The mobile-first beta rebuilds the out-the-door price, checks sample APR and loan terms, flags fees and add-ons, explains what to challenge, and creates editable buyer-controlled wording backed by evidence. EV Mode covers battery warranty and health, real-world range, fast charging, recalls/software, replacement risk, FSD ownership, and depreciation. Fictional sample data only—no autonomous dealer contact.

posts.name: Worde Flow
posts.tagline: turn anything around you into a word puzzle
posts.description: Worde Flow sees what you see and turns it into a word puzzle. Snap anything around you, get a word, and solve the spelling puzzle. Real world. Real words.

posts.name: Meridian Allocation
posts.tagline: Classifying macro regimes instead of predicting markets
posts.description: Meridian Allocation is a rules-based macro allocation research platform for serious self-directed investors. Most portfolios look diversified by asset count but remain concentrated in the same macro risks. The aim is not to predict every market move. It is to create a transparent and repeatable process for deciding how a portfolio should behave across different environments. It is a monthly allocation decision record that can be reviewed, challenged, and judged over time.

posts.name: FlockConnect
posts.tagline: Pastoral care tracking for churches, $9/mo flat
posts.description: FlockConnect is a Church Relationship Manager (ChRM). It works alongside your existing church software: log pastoral care in seconds, assign care partners, run guided care reports, track follow-ups. Planning Center sync + CSV import. Flat $9/mo, any church size.

posts.name: Spark7
posts.tagline: The most addictive number drop puzzle game for your brain
posts.description: Spark7 is like Drop7 on steroids – as if Tetris, Dr. Mario, CandyCrush, Sudoku, and 2048 got together and had a baby to become even more satisfying and engaging. The gameplay seems simple at first. Just drop numbered balls into the grid, match them by count, and chain explosive combos (“surges”) to boost your score. But very quickly, you’ll find yourself gradually understanding the game’s hidden nuances over time, continuing to improve your skills and your brainpower during every moment of play.

posts.name: BuildMint Queue
posts.tagline: Simple queue management for walk-in businesses
posts.description: BuildMint Queue is a simple queue management system for clinics, salons, repair shops, and other walk-in businesses. Staff manage queues from a dashboard while customers track their place on their phone, so they can wait anywhere without losing their turn.

posts.name: Life Rating
posts.tagline: Rate your life — See how successful you are
posts.description: Take the Life Rating test. Get your life overall score, potential and action plan.
